verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Kino AI publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The MCP server and the llms.txt file are adjacent agent-integration features, not an API specification. A video-editing SaaS could plausibly ship such a spec, so the axis applies and absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
